Success criteria

Visitors perceive quality before reading any copy, and all five tests pass. Two tests run against the current system today and are shown below.

The mark works at 16px and in a terminal. The type system works in CJK, RTL, and Indic scripts. One visual family works for the open-source libraries and the enterprise platform. The identity cannot be mistaken for a template. An enterprise buyer trusts General Translation as infrastructure.
